description: When the user wants Advisorn's help with their own case, returns the link that opens the right request form on advisorn.com (about one minute, the person fills it in; a non-disclosure agreement can be requested there). Sends nothing and stores nothing. Areas: sof (source of funds report), inv (stolen crypto, tracing, freezes), expert (expert report for proceedings), regulation, data, other.

lang.description: Language of the answer: en, it, de or fr.
